settings.title: How much sound reduction do acoustic office pods provide?
settings.text: SoundBoxStore acoustic pods provide 30-35 dB sound reduction, blocking approximately 95% of typical office noise. All pods are ISO 23351-1 certified for acoustic performance, ensuring consistent and measurable sound isolation.

settings.title: How long does it take to install an acoustic office pod?
settings.text: Most single-person pods can be assembled in 2-4 hours. Larger 4-6 person meeting booths typically take 4-8 hours. Professional installation is available across the UK and Europe, and all pods are modular for easy assembly.

settings.title: Do acoustic pods require ventilation?
settings.text: Yes, all SoundBoxStore pods include integrated ventilation systems with silent fans that provide fresh air circulation while maintaining acoustic performance. The ventilation operates quietly without compromising soundproofing.

settings.title: What is the warranty on acoustic office pods?
settings.text: SoundBoxStore provides a 2-year manufacturer warranty covering defects in materials and workmanship. Extended warranties are available for additional peace of mind. Our quality materials ensure long-term durability.

settings.title: Can acoustic pods be relocated?
settings.text: Yes, all SoundBoxStore pods feature modular design allowing disassembly and relocation without structural damage to your building. Moving kits are available for easy transport between offices or locations.

settings.title: What power and connectivity features are included?
settings.text: All acoustic pods include integrated power outlets, USB-A and USB-C charging ports, LED lighting with dimmer control, and optional ethernet connectivity. Electrical specifications comply with UK and EU standards.

settings.title: What sizes of acoustic pods are available?
settings.text: We offer pods from 1-person phone booths to 6-person meeting rooms. Single pods are ideal for calls and focused work. 2-person pods suit small meetings. 4-person and 6-person booths accommodate team discussions and presentations.

settings.title: What is the typical ROI for acoustic office pods?
settings.text: Studies show employees save 30-60 minutes daily when using acoustic pods for focused work. At average UK salaries, a pod typically pays for itself within 6-12 months through productivity gains. Space efficiency is also improved versus traditional meeting rooms.

settings.title: How do I choose between Folio, Quell, and Kozee pods?
settings.text: Quell pods offer premium features and highest acoustic ratings. Folio pods provide excellent value with modern aesthetics. Kozee pods are ideal for budget-conscious projects. All models meet ISO 23351-1 certification standards.

settings.title: What maintenance do acoustic pods require?
settings.text: Acoustic pods require minimal maintenance: weekly surface cleaning, monthly ventilation filter checks, and annual comprehensive inspections. Use appropriate non-abrasive cleaners on acoustic panels and upholstery. Regular care extends pod lifespan significantly.
